prose: The Simons Foundation, with Anthropic and OpenAI, is committing $15 million in combined funding and resources to help mathematicians deal with AI. The foundation will manage and award the money, partly through an open call for proposals.
It will pay for workshops and initiatives to evaluate recent AI-assisted results, teach tools, share views and shape shared standards for AI use in mathematics.
highlights: Open call for proposals on evaluating AI-assisted math results.
